== English Virtual Original comparison ==
The later slip removes the entire character-weapons-in-an-attack-this-turn choice. Period attack rules ordinarily limit weapons to participants, with exceptions requiring their own text. The move-phase attack, ferocious creature relocation subject to habitat, and canceling Reegesk plus loss remain.
